title: Sixth amendment: real resync phase proof (replace the false-positive join-as-resync check)
frozen_before: any reevaluation or actual-002 measurement under the corrected resync proof

supersedes.note: Additive. Amendment 5, its receipts and the preserved actual-full-001 artifacts remain immutable history. Original predeclared.json, protocol.sha256 and all prior contracts/pins/receipts are preserved.

reason: The injected scenario submitted ResyncNextBar after StopNow and then started a third join; any new step plus a last-step change set resync_effect_observed, so an ordinary join passed even if Resync was ignored. This is a false positive in the first-slice resync proof.

resync_phase_proof.procedure: After the second-join StopNow proof, start a THIRD actual join (paced) and wait for engine injectedPlaying plus new steps with NO resync yet. Advance paced callbacks until the baseline injectedNextStep() is in [2,14] (not the downbeat 1) and the engine is playing. Record baseline injectedNextStep(), injectedLastStepSample(), injectedCommandCount() and injectedSamplePosition() (submit cursor). Submit ResyncNextBar alone (no concurrent Start). Advance paced callbacks (bounded 2 s) until injectedCommandCount() advances and injectedStepsFired() advances while playing. Assert the resulting injectedNextStep()==1 (step 0 fired), injectedLastStepSample() in [submitCursor, audioOwnerAfter), and a positive command-count delta.
resync_phase_proof.rationale: requestResyncNextBar sends a ResyncBar at the current worker cursor; the engine rephases so step 0 fires at the next serviced callback. The baseline phase in [2,14] proves a normal next step would not be 0, so the observed step-0 event is attributable to the resync and not to an ordinary join.
resync_phase_proof.gate: injected join gate requires resync_phase_before in [2,14], resync_phase_after==1, submit_cursor <= step_sample < observed_end, owner_command_delta >= 1 and resync_effect_observed true. Missing fields fail even if resync_effect_observed is true.

defaultlong_gate.note: The default-long gate remains identity plus actual audio-owner advancement; it does not require injected-specific fields. The paced/wall checks apply to the injected scenario only.

semantics_unchanged: structural AND rt_gate AND join_gate; default no-lock diagnostic; the 54-cell matrix, pacing and expected ids are unchanged. Only the injected resync proof is strengthened.
